note: Values of the Mars place tools (assets-src/mars/place). oldLadder: the levels of main that the old land is read from.

dehaze.note: dehaze.py: the dark envelope of the place picture by distance from the twin and picture column; landKnee and landMost: the luminance of the land (scene) is bent over above landKnee and never passes landMost (what is brighter in the picture is taken as glow)

lead.note: lead.py: light is what the globe multiplies a lit level with near the ground at T (r g b, measured with flat.sh and light.py); the old land keeps its brightness and is moved by paletteMix to the hue of the picture's land (paletteHue, the median where the lay back leads at 1.2 deg) inside paletteCoreDeg, fading out to paletteEndDeg; paletteMix is 0 since the eighth bake (it was 0.85 and made a grey disc of 8 degrees on the red land): the hue of the land goes to the picture's by height, with the tint of src/stops/mars/near.json, which bake.py and topdown.py read through geom.near_tint

force.note: force.py: pictureStep is the grid of the twin's picture the comparison runs on (picture px), blurPx the blur of the difference (picture px), share how much of it is added, directFrom to directTo the stretch (plate texels per picture px) over which the lay back itself stops being used; spreadDeg is how far outside the fan the difference fades out (degrees on the ground), spreadShare its share at the edge, spreadBlurPx the blur of the spread field (plate px); edgePx the feather of the fan edge on the plate (plate px); calmShare how far the broad colour of the far fan (seen, but through thick haze) is brought to the land around it, calmBlurDeg the blur of that comparison (degrees), calmLeast and calmMost the limits of the ratio; groundBlur: the difference is blurred on the ground with a radius of blurPx x stretch x groundBlur plate px; calmHue how far the far fan takes the hue of the land around; outside the fan the broad tone of the take (blur of toneBlur of the plate width) is brought by a gain (toneLeast to toneMost) to the tone at the nearest edge of the fan, fading over spreadDeg; holdFromDeg to holdToDeg: the ground one picture px covers along the view (degrees) over which the hold and the sharp lay back fall away, about 0.33 to 0.5 degrees from the twin's foot (cliff faces laid back over the land behind them read from above as strokes that run out from the twin); beyond it only the broad tone of the picture is held, the difference blurred round on the ground over broadDeg and applied as a gain on the take between broadLeast and broadMost (texel values; as a sum the hazy far ground of the picture turned the take grey white); broadHue: how far the hue of that broad tone goes to the picture's (the limits broadLeast and broadMost hold for its lightness only); broadDetail: the power on the fine drawing of the take beyond the hold (its ratio to its own broad tone; 1 keeps it, 0 leaves only the broad tone), broadColour: the share of the fine colour kept there (0: the fine drawing is light and dark only); nearDeg: outside the fan the tone follows the held near ground of the picture within this distance of it (degrees), beyond it the tone of the nearest edge of the fan; toneShade: where that gain darkens, the shaded ground takes more of it than the lit ground (0: all alike); edgeWander: the edge of the fan is drawn back from the straight edge of the picture's field by up to this share of the plate width, far where the take is bright at that scale, so it runs along forms of the land; grainFromDeg to grainToDeg: the distance from the fan (degrees) over which the ground outside it takes the grain of the fan (the shade weight falls away and the fine contrast of the take, over grainBlur of the plate width, is brought to that of the fan at the nearest edge, never below grainLeast of its own)

nest.note: nestbase.py: matchFloor by plate width (degrees): the share of the broad tone match to the plate above that holds over the whole nested take, not only at its rim. Measured on the fifth bake: the takes were 0.36 to 0.44 in red (texel values) with red over green 1.9 to 2.2 where the old land round the place is 0.26 to 0.30 with 2.6 to 2.75, so the place stood pale and grey in the globe from 34 to 11 degrees across (frames 2413 to 2426).

bake.note: bake.py: plates from the deepest up (look: the plate of force.py, empty for the toned old land), the new lit level, the lit levels above that take the difference, the options of the stop; matchBlur and matchReach (shares of the plate width): the broad difference to the plate above is added at the rim and fades out matchReach inside it; matchLeast and matchMost bound the gain of the rim match; lookKnee and lookMost: the luminance of a plate (look values) is bent over above lookKnee and never passes lookMost
bake.ladderNote: Eight levels: 96, 42, 19 lit (4096 px); 8.5 (3686), 3.8 (4096), 1.6 (3686), 0.7 (3277), 0.3 (3277) with their own light. Chosen with predict.py --minor on the paths of E3 (main 03510ddd): dive worst 0.0082, rise worst about 0.016 of ground pixels under 1.0 texels. The 8.5 level at 3686 px reads the same as at 4096 and frees 17 MB: the full set then stands near 1376 MB of 1400. Smaller 42 or 19 levels fail in the rise (0.042 at 2724, 0.035 at 2720). Nine levels with every density doubled would need 53 MB more than the set may use.

matte.note: matte.py (values in field px at scale 1 and in shares of the margin depth): formPx the blur against which the light and dark of the land is taken, smoothPx the blur of that difference, formShare how far a form moves the cut across the margin, rampIn the depth over which the forms come in from the frame's edge, cut and soft the level and half width of the cut; where dehaze.py's t (blurred) is under tFrom to tTo the picture is haze or sky and the matte is a ramp from airFrom to airTo of the depth; endFrom to endTo: the matte is 0 before the field's own edge
